name: Witch School Romp!
source:
It's your first day at a former all-girls school, and you're one of its very first male students. Nerves aside, your classmates welcome you warmly. Then you learn the truth: this is no ordinary school, but a school for witches. And you have no magic whatsoever.

With a few charming witches covering for you, you start hiding your secret and settling into an education you were never meant to receive. But it soon becomes clear that your presence here isn't a coincidence. You may carry a power unlike anything this world has seen.

Can you uncover what the school is hiding, and maybe find love while you're at it?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.interactive_studio.mazyogakuen]Google Play[/url]]
